step1_analysis.circuit_type: Differential Cascode Low-Noise Amplifier (LNA) with Auxiliary Mixer/Buffer
step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of a differential cascode LNA (XM1/XM8 and XM3/XM6) designed for RF applications, accompanied by a differential pair (XM4/XM5) likely acting as a mixer or output buffer, and a current mirror (XM2/XM7) for biasing. It is used to study the effects of substrate noise coupling in mixed-signal CMOS GPS receivers.

paper_reference.title: Measuring and Modeling the Effects of Substrate Noise on the LNA for a CMOS GPS Receiver

voltage_gain.description: Maximum AC voltage gain of the LNA at the resonant frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen load impedance and bias current. 16 dB is typical for a 5kOhm tuned load at 0.9V gate bias.

peak_frequency.description: Frequency at which the LNA achieves maximum gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)) with L=10uH and C=6.3pF
sky130_expected.reasoning: Tuned by the external LC tank in the testbench to match the paper's 20 MHz figure.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly listed, but typical for LNA is a few mW

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total * VDD. I_total ~ 310uA per branch * 4 branches = 1.24mA. Power = 1.24mA * 1.8V = 2.2mW
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on 0.9V gate bias and 5um/0.5um NMOS devices operating in saturation.

transient_vpp.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage swing under a 10mV input signal.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the AC voltage gain at the resonant frequency.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the DC power, AC voltage gain, peak resonant frequency, and transient output swing of the differential cascode LNA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LNA Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N15 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N12 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N10 LABEL_NET_2 N11 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N4 N14 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N6 N14 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N13 N8 N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N7 N8 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Sources and Biasing
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 20Meg)
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 DC 0.9 AC 0 SIN(0.9 0 20Meg)
V_N8 N8 0 DC 1.2
V_N4 N4 0 DC 0.9
V_N6 N6 0 DC 0.9
V_N1 N1 0 DC 0.9
V_N15 N15 0 0
V_N11 N11 0 0
V_N14 N14 0 0

* LNA Loads (Tuned to ~20MHz)
L1 VDD N7 10u
R1 VDD N7 5k
C1 N7 0 6.3p

L2 VDD N13 10u
R2 VDD N13 5k
C2 N13 0 6.3p

* Buffer/Mixer Loads
R3 VDD N3 1k
R4 VDD N2 1k
R5 VDD N12 1k

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 50 1Meg 100Meg
let gain_db = vdb(N7)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac peak_freq max_at gain_db

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 200n
meas tran v_max max v(N7)
meas tran v_min min v(N7)
let v_pp = v_max - v_min
print v_pp

quit
.endc
.end
